entities.summary: Wienhausen Abbey or  Convent near Celle in Lower Saxony, Germany, is a convent of Evangelical Lutheran women, which, until the Reformation was a Cistercian Catholic nunnery. The abbey owns significant artworks and artifacts, including a collection of tapestries and the earliest surviving example of a type of eyeglasses.
